# Light › Burn

**What belongs here.** Film or paper burns through.

**Examples.** film burn, burn-through

**Family test.** Does the frame get brighter, glowing or flared at the cut, with an optical (not flat) quality?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Film Burn](film-burn/) | Holes burn through the old scene with glowing edges until the frame is white-hot, then it cools to reveal the new scene. |
